HELPERHUB.AutoHint: Play the TV static transition when switching to a scene that has no transition type of its own.
HELPERHUB.ForceHint: Use TV static even when the scene already has a transition type. Automatic mode must also be enabled.
HELPERHUB.DurationHint: Duration, in milliseconds, used when this module injects a TV static transition.
HELPERHUB.IntensityHint: Strength of the interference. Zero leaves a bare cut; one is full static.
HELPERHUB.VolumeHint: Volume of the synthesized static hiss. Zero mutes it. Multiplied by the global ambient volume.
HELPERHUB.DropNotImage: Only image files can be dropped into chat.
HELPERHUB.DropNoPermission: You do not have permission to upload files.
HELPERHUB.DropPostFailed: The images uploaded, but the chat message could not be posted.
HELPERHUB.LinkPostFailed: The link could not be posted to chat.
HELPERHUB.DropBusy: An image upload is already in progress.
HELPERHUB.DropUrlUnsupported: Only an image or YouTube link can be dropped into chat.
HELPERHUB.PlaylistNotYouTube: That link is not a YouTube video.
